listitem.para: Each Service Pack defines a default PHP major version (7.2 in SP0/SP1, 7.4 in SP2/SP3, 8.0 in SP4/SP5, 8.2 in SP6, 8.4 in SP7). Older versions move to the Legacy Module. PHP patch updates are released reactively for CVEs and bug fixes.
Tomcat 11 is available starting in &suselinux; 15 SP6. It features a 1-year initial commitment with a goal of a 6-month support overlap with the next major version.
